title: "Bootstrap"
format: html

## 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(irr)

#' Run a Bootstrap Simulation for Rater Reliability (Corrected for List Structure)
#' 
#' @param df_list List of dataframes, where each dataframe is ONE article.
#' @param ai_raters Vector of names of the AI raters.
#' @param n_iterations Number of bootstrap iterations.
run_bootstrap_simulation_final <- function(df_list,
                                           ai_raters,
                                           n_iterations = 1000) {

  # --- 1. Data Preparation: Assign Article IDs ---
  message("Assigning Article IDs based on list index...")
  
  # We iterate through the list index (1, 2, 3...) and add that number as a column.
  # This ensures that "Item 1.0" from Article 1 is distinct from "Item 1.0" from Article 2.
  df_list_labeled <- lapply(seq_along(df_list), function(i) {
    d <- df_list[[i]]
    
    # Force all columns to character to avoid type mismatches (e.g. logical vs char)
    d <- d %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
    
    # Create the Article ID
    d$Article_ID <- paste0("Article_", i)
    return(d)
  })
  
  combined_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_list_labeled)
  
  # Identify the unique units of analysis (The Articles)
  all_article_ids <- unique(combined_df$Article_ID)
  n_articles <- length(all_article_ids)
  
  message(paste("Processing", n_articles, "unique articles."))

  # --- 2. Helper Function: Kappa Calculation ---
  calculate_summary_kappas <- function(data) {
    # Identify raters by excluding metadata columns
    meta_cols <- c("Number", "Article_ID", "sample_id")
    present_raters <- setdiff(names(data), meta_cols)
    
    # Prepare containers
    kappas <- list(intra_ai = c(), intra_human = c(), ai_human = c())

    # Generate all possible pairs from the columns present in this sample
    rater_pairs <- combn(present_raters, 2, simplify = FALSE)

    for (pair in rater_pairs) {
      r1 <- pair[1]
      r2 <- pair[2]
      
      # Extract data for this pair
      pair_data <- data %>%
        select(all_of(c(r1, r2))) %>%
        # IMPORTANT: Convert "NOT PRESENT" to NA if you want to exclude it, 
        # or keep it if it's a valid category. 
        # irr::kappa2 automatically drops rows with NAs.
        filter(!is.na(.[[1]]) & !is.na(.[[2]]))

      # Only calculate if we have enough overlap (e.g., >5 items)
      if (nrow(pair_data) >= 5) {
        
        # Use "unweighted" for nominal data (Yes/No/Not Present)
        k_val <- tryCatch({
          irr::kappa2(pair_data, weight = "unweighted")$value
        }, error = function(e) NA)

        if (!is.na(k_val)) {
          is_r1_ai <- r1 %in% ai_raters
          is_r2_ai <- r2 %in% ai_raters
          
          if (is_r1_ai && is_r2_ai) {
            kappas$intra_ai <- c(kappas$intra_ai, k_val)
          } else if (!is_r1_ai && !is_r2_ai) {
            kappas$intra_human <- c(kappas$intra_human, k_val)
          } else {
            kappas$ai_human <- c(kappas$ai_human, k_val)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Return averages
    return(data.frame(
      intra_ai_kappa    = ifelse(length(kappas$intra_ai) > 0, mean(kappas$intra_ai, na.rm=TRUE), NA),
      intra_human_kappa = ifelse(length(kappas$intra_human) > 0, mean(kappas$intra_human, na.rm=TRUE), NA),
      ai_human_kappa    = ifelse(length(kappas$ai_human) > 0, mean(kappas$ai_human, na.rm=TRUE), NA)
    ))
  }

  # --- 3. Bootstrap Loop ---
  message(paste("Running", n_iterations, "bootstrap iterations..."))
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_iterations, style = 3)
  results_list <- list()

  for (i in 1:n_iterations) {
    
    # A. Sample Article IDs (Cluster Bootstrap)
    # We sample N articles with replacement.
    sampled_ids <- sample(all_article_ids, n_articles, replace = TRUE)
    
    # B. Create Sampling Frame
    # This table records which articles we picked, allowing duplicates.
    sampling_frame <- data.frame(
      Article_ID = sampled_ids,
      sample_id = 1:n_articles # Unique ID for this specific bootstrap instance
    )
    
    # C. Join to get the full data
    # This grabs ALL items (1.0, 1.1...) for every sampled article.
    # If Article_1 is sampled twice, it appears twice here.
    temp_df <- sampling_frame %>%
      left_join(combined_df, by = "Article_ID", relationship = "many-to-many")
      
    # D. Calculate Metrics for this sample
    results_list[[i]] <- calculate_summary_kappas(temp_df)
    
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  }
  
  close(pb)
  return(dplyr::bind_rows(results_list))
}
```

```{r}

ai_raters <- c("GG", "AC", "OC")
bootstrap_results <- run_bootstrap_simulation_final(
  df_list = alldata,
  ai_raters = ai_raters,
  n_iterations = 1000
)

summary(bootstrap_results)

bootstrap_results_v2 <- bootstrap_results
```

```{r}
ci_ai <- quantile(bootstrap_results_v2$intra_ai_kappa, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
ci_human <- quantile(bootstrap_results_v2$intra_human_kappa, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
ci_ai_human <- quantile(bootstrap_results_v2$ai_human_kappa, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("95% CI for Intra-AI Kappa:    ", round(ci_ai, 3), "\n")
cat("95% CI for Intra-Human Kappa:  ", round(ci_human, 3), "\n")
cat("95% CI for AI-Human Kappa:     ", round(ci_ai_human, 3), "\n")

```

```{r}
# --- 5. (Optional) Visualize the Distributions ---
# install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)

# Reshape data for plotting
plot_data_v2 <- bootstrap_results_v2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "group", values_to = "kappa")

ggplot(plot_data_v2, aes(x = kappa, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("intra_ai_kappa" = "skyblue", "intra_human_kappa" = "salmon", "ai_human_kappa" = "lightgreen"),
    labels = c("AI-Human", "Intra-AI", "Intra-Human")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Distributions of Rater Reliability",
    subtitle = "Comparing Intra-AI, Intra-Human, and AI-Human Agreement",
    x = "Average Weighted Kappa",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Rater Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
